keyboard.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
keyboard.subtitle: Use keyboard to quickly operate Pixuli

usageTips.title: Usage Tips
usageTips.tip1: Shortcuts won't work in input fields, text areas and other editable elements
usageTips.tip2: Press F5 to open this help; ↑↓ scrolls the list
usageTips.tip3: Press Esc to close help and return to the library
usageTips.tip4: ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens or re-edits search; ⌘⇧K / Ctrl+Shift+K clears the query
usageTips.tip5: Edit dialog: Esc cancels; Enter or ⌘↵ / Ctrl+Enter saves locally
usageTips.tip6: Press M to enter multi-select; ↑↓ moves focus, Space toggles, Esc exits

shortcuts.selectUp: Select previous resource (move focus in multi-select)
shortcuts.selectDown: Select next resource (move focus in multi-select)
shortcuts.shareSelected: Copy share link for selected file
